root_causes: The first documentation PR commit set changed meaningful files but omitted the required machine-readable record under configs/process/cycles/.

findings: Documentation changes are subject to the same cumulative lifecycle gate as other meaningful changes.
A diagnostic predicate matching a published membership set does not, by itself, establish the publisher's historical selection semantics.
A successful workflow with skipped source-backed scientific jobs is not scientific validation.
The repository's product description already expresses the cross-platform CPU-first platform direction; installer and OS support claims still require test evidence.

open_blockers: Validate this lifecycle record with the repository validator.
Re-run all PR checks on the final documentation branch head.
Keep Issue #170 open until source-backed scientific semantics are resolved.
Do not claim the 11602-row report, 100-object benchmark, Windows/macOS installers, or finished desktop GUI are complete without their respective evidence.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not weaken or bypass the lifecycle gate.

Do not modify scientific selection logic, model artifacts, or production database/schema as part of a documentation-only change.
